property_summary: For any non-empty list of recipients, C.transfer must forward each recipient to the target contract using the ERC-20 transferFrom selector (0x23b872dd), so a recording callee must observe every recipient encoded with that selector; the mutant uses the ERC-20 transfer selector instead, so the callee records the wrong selector.
change_summary: Changed the transferFrom selector string to an incorrect one, so calls are made with a different external function selector and the wrapped call may return true for a different operation.
